request: Fix writeBaselineManifest in src/cli/install.js: listFiles(target) walks the entire target directory unfiltered when building .claude/.baseline-manifest.json, capturing consumer-owned files (e.g. Cargo.toml, src/main.rs) and everything under .git/ as if they were baseline-shipped files. A later upgrade prunes them because they're absent from the real template manifest. Fix: scope the manifest to the actual shipped file set already computed at install time (tplFiles/newManifest.files keys), and unconditionally exclude .git/.
novelty_evidence: bin/cli.js:124 listShippedFiles(templateDir) and src/cli/tui/upgrade.js:212 listShippedFiles both already build the shipped-file list by walking templateDir, not target, for the same reason this fix needs; install.js's listFiles(target) is the one place that still walks the wrong tree.
